latency_scope: Host wall including native target packing, isolated head and z-loss forward/backward, collective submission and completion, and CUDA synchronization. Excludes start barrier, memory reads, and reset-output digest.
latency_aggregation: For each aligned measured iteration 11–20, take the maximum elapsed wall time across eight ranks; report the median of those ten maxima.
memory_scope: Maximum GIFT total GPU memory estimate across all eight ranks and timed iterations 11–20.
throughput_scope: Effective head-only physical input TPS uses 65536 tokens per replay (8 ranks × local batch 2 × sequence length 4096), divided by each iteration's maximum rank elapsed wall time. It is a component metric, not full-training TPS.
